from pathlib import Path
prog=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs/task-54929ffb.py')
prog.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
prog.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    """Recover the zero-masked rectangular patch from its 180-degree counterpart."""
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    rows = [r for r, _ in coords]
    cols = [c for _, c in coords]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[height - 1 - r][width - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
''')
